title: Stormlog Studio workspace items v1
description: GET /api/v1/workspace/items (design §5.4), written by workspace.ArtifactScanner.items: one page of the files the last scan listed, sorted by path, with the filter that chose them. Paging is keyset on the path, so a cursor stays valid across rescans.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the path, as given.

total.description: Items matching the filter, on every page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; null on the last page.

kind.description: inference_artifact: JSONL with infer.session or infer.request records. audio_artifact: JSONL with infer.audio.* records, unsupported in slice 1. report: a stormlog.report v1 envelope. run_envelope: a stormlog.run_envelope v1 file.

session_id.description: Artifacts: the first infer.session record's session_id, else the first infer.request's. Reports: the envelope's session_id.

status.description: Artifacts: the status of the last infer.session record classify read. For a file over 64 KiB only its last 32 KiB count, so null means no session record there, not that the run has no status.

verdict.description: Reports only: verdict.status, an exit_codes verdict.

ns.description: Integer nanoseconds since the Unix epoch on the client's clock, written as a decimal string because JavaScript numbers lose integer precision above 2^53 (design §5.1). A missing value is null, never "0".
